scoring_justification: The final theoretical quantities are obtained by a full ab initio pipeline that cannot be re-executed in the verifier sandbox; scoring by comparing reported values against paper gold with an appropriate tolerance is the only feasible method.

outputs.description: Final corrected SCF and MP2 deuterium quadrupole coupling constant (kHz) and asymmetry parameter for C6H5D.

output_contract.notes: The scoring tolerance for DQCC values is ±2 kHz; eta values are checked for range compliance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for SCF and MP2 DQCC and acceptable eta range for C6H5D.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported theoretical values after rovibrational corrections for benzene-d1.
